title: Five ways to work with me
lede: Matched to your actual capacity and budget — from a full build to filling a specific gap on your own team.

capacity.title: Can a one-person studio handle your scale?
capacity.body: Small projects are handled solo. Medium projects are supplemented with a trusted freelance network. Larger productions are joined as an embedded specialist within a bigger team. You get senior-level attention either way — the studio scales the team to the project, not the other way around.
capacity.russel: Right tool, right moment — ready to build something clever together?

fullProduction.title: Full-service game production
fullProduction.summary: Concept to finished product, fixed-price small and medium HTML5 games. You know the cost upfront.
fullProduction.for: Brands and agencies who want a finished game and a single point of accountability from kickoff to delivery.
fullProduction.done: A tested, polished, playable game delivered on the agreed platforms — see the Process page for the full sequence.

designArtUiux.title: Modular Service
designArtUiux.summary: Standalone design, art, or UI/UX deliverables for teams that already have dev capacity but need design or IP-handling expertise.
designArtUiux.for: Teams with development capacity that need a game designer, artist, or UX specialist who knows how to work within brand guidelines.
designArtUiux.done: Design docs, art assets, or UI/UX specs your team can build from directly.

conceptFeedback.title: Game concept or feedback
conceptFeedback.summary: Expert feedback on an existing concept, or a concept built from scratch for internal buy-in or a funding application.
conceptFeedback.for: Teams that need a second opinion on a concept, or need one built before committing to full production.
conceptFeedback.done: A written concept or feedback report you can take into a pitch, a funding application, or a green-light meeting.

updatingRebranding.title: Updating & rebranding
updatingRebranding.summary: Refreshing or reskinning an existing game — new visuals, an IP swap, extending its usable life.
updatingRebranding.for: Anyone with an existing game that still works but looks dated, or that could be reskinned for a new IP or campaign.
updatingRebranding.done: The same game, refreshed — new visuals or a new IP applied without rebuilding the mechanic from scratch.

embeddedTeam.title: Embedded team support
embeddedTeam.summary: Project-based game designer, art director, UI/UX designer, or producer capacity to cover gaps, spikes, or sickness within your team.
embeddedTeam.for: Studios and agencies that need extra senior capacity for a defined stretch, without a permanent hire.
embeddedTeam.done: A specific role covered, on your timeline, for as long as the project needs it.
